offline_unit_tests.scope: contract validation, request preservation, reference hashes, review bookkeeping and synthetic PNG fixtures; no artistic evaluation

privacy: No user source photos, generated images, API keys or tokens in the committed files
limitations: A Skill needs a real compatible host image tool
The included CLI does not execute inference
Reviewer-supplied evidence is not independently verified
Only PNG/JPEG header checks are performed; the host must decode and view output
The style lock governs reference and prompt inputs, not pixel determinism

remote_offline_unit_tests.scope: same offline suite; not visual generation
